title: stenorrhynchos cinnabarinum
intro: Stenorrhynchos cinnabarinum, commonly known as the Red Bird's Tongue, is a plant species in the Orchidaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of coughs, colds, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Stenorrhynchos cinnabarinum include its expectorant and antitussive properties, making it useful in treating bronchitis and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
